summary: Downey should retain a true municipal control row. Official City sources show Downey is a full-service city with an active Downey Police Department, and the department's records unit prepares state and federal crime statistics. California DOJ's official Crime in California 2024 report says Downey Police Department was unable to report in 2024 due to system issues, so the current all-fill state reflects reporting continuity failure on CA0192000 rather than an invalid municipal target or a sheriff-primary service structure.
